title: SlackBench: Benchmarking Agents on Collaborative Projects Grounded in Real Code Repositories
abstract: arXiv:2611.05512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI Agents are becoming digital coworkers that can browse the web, write code, run experiments, and assist humans over extended horizons. Yet existing benchmarks fall short of real knowledge work: many rely on synthetic data or isolated tasks, missing the complex, multi-party dynamics of collaborative projects, where critical information is scattered across conversations, code, and evolving decisions. Even simple workplace questions may require locating relevant channels and direct messages, recovering context from long discussions, inspecting repository state, reconciling stale or conflicting evidence, and synthesizing across sources.   We introduce SlackBench, a benchmark for evaluating agents on realistic research and engineering workflows that require joint reasoning over workplace communication and evolving repository state. translated_title: SlackBench：基于真实代码仓库的协作项目中智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: AI智能体正在成为数字同事，它们能够浏览网页、编写代码、运行实验，并在较长时间跨度内协助人类工作。然而，现有基准测试难以反映真实的知识工作：许多基准依赖于合成数据或孤立任务，忽略了协作项目中复杂的多方动态——在这种项目中，关键信息散布在对话、代码和不断演变的决策之中。即使是简单的工作场所问题，也可能需要定位相关频道和私信、从冗长的讨论中恢复上下文、检查仓库状态、调和过时或相互冲突的证据，并进行跨来源的综合分析。我们提出了SlackBench，这是一个用于评估智能体在现实研究与工程工作流中表现的基准，这些工作流需要对工作场所沟通与不断演变的仓库状态进行联合推理。SlackBench基于真实学术研究项目的隐私保护重现构建，提供了可复现的……
tldr: SlackBench是一个基于真实学术研究项目隐私保护重现构建的基准测试，用于评估AI智能体在需要对工作场所沟通与不断演变的代码仓库状态进行联合推理的现实协作研究与工程工作流中的能力。
en_tdlr: SlackBench is a benchmark grounded in privacy-preserving reenactments of real academic research projects, designed to evaluate AI agents on realistic collaborative research and engineering workflows that require joint reasoning over workplace communications and evolving code repository states.
